name: omni-fin-portal
description: Global Currency, Gold, and Financial Analysis Tool Engine

paragraphs: A Next.js 14 (App Router) + Tailwind CSS finance portal.

(36 fiat currencies + 12 cryptocurrencies + 5 precious/base metals, any asset to any other, searchable pickers, rate matrix), a Metals & Commodities Calculator covering Gold, Silver, Platinum, Palladium, Copper (all auto-filled from live spot prices, by weight unit and — for gold — karat) and Crude Oil (auto-filled, priced per barrel), and a worldwide unit converter (length, area, weight, volume, speed, digital storage, temperature — including Tola, Maund, Seer, Marla and Kanal), all tabbed together with programmatic SEO routes for both currency pairs and unit pairs.

calculators across two category tabs — Trading Tools (Position & Lot Size, Pip Value, Risk/Reward Ratio, Margin & Leverage) and Wealth & Personal Finance (Inflation & Purchasing Power, Compound Interest / Wealth Growth, Business Profit Margin & Markup). The same calculators are also embedded as compact "quick mini-widgets" inside relevant Academy lessons and Converter pages. See "Notes on the Calculators Hub" below for the full breakdown.

Without them, both features work exactly as they always did: localStorage-only, single browser, no sign-in.

Each item is tagged with its feed's category, a rule-based sentiment (computeSentiment() — a keyword scan against small hand-picked Bullish/Bearish word lists, always computed, no API key needed), and relatedAssets (detectRelatedAssets() — a word-boundary-aware keyword match against ASSETKEYWORDS, e.g.

Verified end-to- end with a standalone Node script exercising every function with known numbers (e.g. a $10,000 account risking 1% with a 20-pip stop at $10/pip → exactly 0.5 standard lots / 5 mini / 50 micro; a 50-pip risk vs. 100-pip reward → exactly a 1:2 ratio; $50,000 notional at 1:100 leverage on a $1,000 account → exactly $500 required margin and a 200% margin level).
